On a shared path, keep to one side and single file where needed. Give cyclists room to pass at a safe, wider spot; avoid sudden moves, and keep children and dogs close. If you’re cycling, slow down, give a polite warning well in advance, and pass only when there’s enough space.

A walk description should call a path shared or say cycling is allowed only after checking the signs or another reliable, dated source. Note any verified restrictions and where they apply; don’t infer access from the path’s appearance.
